import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];
    static long[] totalarea = new long[100];
    static long[] blockarea = new long[100];
    static long[] dp = new long[100];
    static long[] bp = new long[100];
    static long bestfreq = 0;
    static long best = 0;
    static long m1 = 0;
    static long m2 = 0;
    static long n = 0;
    static long R = 0;
    static long C = 0;
    static String str = "";

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 40; j++) {
                if (j > i) {
                    ncr[i][j] = 0;
                    continue;
                }
                if (j == 0 || j == i) {
                    ncr[i][j] = 1;
                    continue;
                }
                ncr[i][j] = ncr[i - 1][j - 1] + ncr[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        R = sc.nextLong();
        C = sc.nextLong();
        str = sc.next();
        n = R + C;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                blockarea[i * n + j] = ncr[i][R - 1] * ncr[j][R - 1];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                totalarea[i * (n + 1) + j] = 0;
                if (i == 0 || j == 0) continue;
                totalarea[i * (n + 1) + j] = totalarea[(i - 1) * (n + 1) + j] + totalarea[i * (n + 1) + j - 1] - totalarea[(i - 1) * (n + 1) + j - 1];
                totalarea[i * (n + 1) + j] += blockarea[(i - 1) * n + j - 1];
            }
        }
        best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        m1 = (-best + totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]) / 2;
        m2 = totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n] - m1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i * (n + 1) + j] = 0;
                bp[i * (n + 1) + j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dp[0] = 1;
        bp[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i + j + 1 <= 2 * n - 1 && str.charAt(i + j) != 'B') {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                        if (dp[k * (n + 1) + j] > 0 && k + j + 1 <= m2) {
                            dp[(k + 1) * (n + 1) + j] += dp[k * (n + 1) + j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (i + j + 1 <= 2 * n - 1 && str.charAt(n - i + n - j - 1) != 'B') {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                        if (bp[k * (n + 1) + j] > 0 && k + j + 1 <= m2) {
                            bp[(k + 1) * (n + 1) + j] += bp[k * (n + 1) + j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i + j + 1 <= 2 * n - 1 && str.charAt(i + j) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(i + 1) * (n + 1) + j] - totalarea[i * (n + 1) + j];
                    for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                        if (dp[k * (n + 1) + j] > 0 && k + j + 1 + newarea <= m2) {
                            dp[(k + 1) * (n + 1) + j] += dp[k * (n + 1) + j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (i + j + 1 <= 2 * n - 1 && str.charAt(n - i + n - j - 1) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[n - i] * (n + 1) + n - j] - totalarea[n - i - 1] * (n + 1) + n - j];
                    for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                        if (bp[k * (n + 1) + j] > 0 && k + j + 1 + newarea2 <= m2) {
                            bp[(k + 1) * (n + 1) + j] += bp[k * (n + 1) + j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (i + j + 1 <= 2 * n - 1) {
                    dp[i * (n + 1) + j] = 0;
                }
                if (i + j + 1 <= 2 * n - 1) {
                    bp[i * (n + 1) + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            long y = 2 * n - 1 - i;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                if (dp[k * (n + 1) + y] > 0) {
                    bestfreq += dp[k * (n + 1) + y] * bp[n - k] * (n + 1) + n - y][m1 - k];
                    if (m1 != m2) {
                        bestfreq += dp[k * (n + 1) + y] * bp[n - k] * (n + 1) + n - y][m2 - k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
